body.name: supplied validated objective-oracle contract
body.construction:
A supplied validated interval oracle consists of one global rational bound \(L_J\in\mathbb Q_{>0}\) and a map which, for every rational interval \(I\subseteq[-G,G]\) and precision \(m\in\mathbb N\), returns
\[
 \mathfrak O(I,m)=[\underline J(I,m),\overline J(I,m)]\in\mathbb Q^2
\]
such that, relative to the supplied input name, for every \(\eta\in I\),
\[
 J(p,\eta)\in\mathfrak O(I,m),
 \qquad
 \overline J(I,m)-\underline J(I,m)
 \leq L_J\operatorname{diam}(I)+2^{-m},
\]
and a point interval has returned width at most \(2^{-m}\).  The receipts and rational inequalities are part of the oracle contract.  No claim is made here that a Cauchy-name or series sketch by itself supplies a machine-checkable implementation.
